name: Dell Dock WD19S 130W
source_title: Dell Dock WD19S User Guide and Specifications
excerpt: Dell Dock WD19S links your notebook to monitors, peripherals, and network via a single USB-C cable. Supports USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, HDMI 2.0b, up to 90W Power Delivery with 130W adapter, 3x USB 3.1 Gen 1, and Gigabit Ethernet.

evidence_excerpts.model_code: Regulatory Model: K20A; Regulatory Type: K20A001; Commercial Model: WD19S 130W.
evidence_excerpts.category: Dell Commercial Docking Station: WD19S USB-C Dock.
evidence_excerpts.host_connection: Connects to host system through integrated USB-C cable.
evidence_excerpts.requires_usb_c_dp_alt_mode: Host system requires DisplayPort over USB-C (DisplayPort 1.4 or 1.2 Alt Mode) for video.
evidence_excerpts.hdmi_max_resolution: HDMI 2.0b port supports display resolution up to 4K (3840 x 2160).
evidence_excerpts.hdmi_max_refresh_hz: HDMI output supports refresh rate up to 60Hz at 4K.
evidence_excerpts.pd_input_max_w: Operates with Dell 130W AC power adapter.
evidence_excerpts.pd_pass_through_max_w: Delivers up to 90W Power Delivery to Dell and non-Dell USB-C systems.
evidence_excerpts.usb_a_port_count: 3 x USB 3.1 Gen 1 Type-A ports (one with PowerShare).
